method: Fresh isolated rebuild of the pinned tarball plus the reviewed patch and configuration reproduces the deployed shared libc and loader byte for byte; the static archives match member by member

details.recipe: JOBS=$(nproc) bash sdk-src/scripts/rebuild-uclibc.sh out/legal-proof/uclibc-1.0.59 (rebuild script and configuration delivered in the corresponding-source package; isolated proof build directory)
details.static_archive_note: ar records member timestamps, so the archives themselves are not byte-identical across builds; every member object is, which is what the comparison above records. The archives are identified by hash, not claimed reproducible.
details.legacy_source_directory: A legacy local libc tree is 1.0.57 and is deliberately NOT used as 1.0.59 corresponding source
